description: Enforces Bun as the only allowed package manager via the only-allow package. The preinstall hook (only-allow bun) fires before every install and exits with an error if npm, yarn, or pnpm is used instead of bun. The packageManager field in package.json declares bun@1.3.14 as the canonical runtime.
notes: Backfilled by feature-coverage-audit from current implementation evidence on 2026-07-14.
packageManager field and only-allow were added as uncommitted working-tree changes after the 2026-06-10 audit.
engines field also tightened to bun >=1.3.14 and node >=24.0.0 <25.0.0.
Revision 1.1.0 (2026-06-11): only-allow bun preinstall hook and packageManager bun@1.3.14 added, engines field tightened; misleading .nvmrc removed.
spec:
1. Verify `bun install` completes successfully without error.
2. Verify running `npm install` (or yarn/pnpm) triggers the preinstall hook and exits with a non-zero code.
3. Verify the packageManager field in package.json is set to a bun version.
4. Verify the engines field specifies minimum bun and node versions.
5. Verify no .nvmrc file exists — the Node.js version requirement is documented only in the package.json engines field; do NOT add nvm configuration to this Bun-based project.
title: Package Manager Enforcement
